mapper.sql: address_id, user_id, receiver, phone, region, detail, is_default, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into campus_address (user_id, receiver, phone, region, detail, is_default) values (#{userId}, #{receiver}, #{phone}, #{region}, #{detail}, #{isDefault})
mapper.delete: delete from campus_address where address_id = #{addressId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update campus_address set is_default = 0 where user_id = #{userId} and is_default = 1
mapper.select: select count(1) from campus_address where user_id = #{userId}
